pairs.subject: fleet-orchestration
pairs.evidence: src/athena/daemon/server.py:258 The daemon hosts one Athena and runs one turn at a time behind a writer lock, and its Sessions table is per-origin page routing state rather than a set of autonomous agent sessions; searches of src/athena/daemon and tests/daemon for hibernat, roster, broadcast, staleness and sweeper found nothing, so there is no fleet to orchestrate.

techniques.evidence: src/athena/daemon/sessions.py:7 Session is per-origin routing memory for a page socket, not a fleet entry with a lifecycle; it is in memory on purpose.
src/athena/daemon/server.py:258 Writes are serialised to a single turn, so nothing is fanned out and there are no collision domains.
